title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza, Massachusetts Institute of Technology on 1970-05-06
venue: Kresge Plaza, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
source: MSR (MIT Reels) 1/2 Track Mono -> Otari MX 55 2 track (playback) -> TC 2000 Studio Effects Processor (using only the A->D converter, no effects) ->Sonic Solutions (at 20 bits resolution) -> mastered to CD using Sony SBM 2(No DAT generations) -> CD (from Gans) > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Sharp mono soundboard captures a blistering MIT performance highlighted by an incendiary Dancing in the Streets and soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The May 6, 1970 MIT show is repeatedly called a “top‑ten” performance, with the band feeding off the tense post‑Kent State atmosphere to deliver scorching versions of Dancing in the Streets, Morning Dew, Not Fade Away and a fiery St. Stephen/China Rider stretch.  The recording is a mono soundboard feed – raw at times but surprisingly clear and sharp despite noted distortion and mic problems.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for the musical intensity and only a few note technical flaws; the average rating across reviews is ~4.2, indicating a strong show with good but not flawless recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono board feed with occasional distortion, mic and mixing glitches; overall clear, sharp, and surprisingly listenable despite raw edges.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert bursts with angry, high‑energy playing fueled by the recent Kent State tragedy and cold weather; the band stays in a relentless zone, delivering intense jams that keep momentum from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Thrashing on his SG, especially during Not Fade Away and the high‑octane jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Delivers one of his most devastating bass runs on Dancing in the Streets.
band_member_comments.Bob: Adds vocal urgency, noted for announcing the free show and commenting on the cold conditions.
